title: H2O Zone
specs: Lake Powell location with access to 20 miles of lake and four canyons
Personalized 30-45 minute safety and equipment introduction
Must wear USCG-approved Type III life jacket at all times
Must provide valid driver’s license or passport
Minimum age 18 to operate personal watercraft
No boating license required if 18 or older
Vehicle with towing capabilities and 2-inch hitch ball required or rent tow vehicle
Daily rentals require minimum two jet skis for groups up to four riders
Each jet ski seats up to two riders
includes: Refueling instructions and full fuel at pickup
blurb: Guests rent personal watercraft for full-day or multi-day use on Lake Powell. Rentals include a safety introduction, a waterproof map, and life jackets. Tow vehicles and hitches are available for rent or loan to assist with launching.
extraNote: Full-day rentals only; minimum 2 jet skis for daily rentals · Security deposit $500 per personal watercraft, held on credit card · No credit card required to hold reservation; payment due on arrival · Cancellation charges waived if weather is unsafe; operator may reschedule or cancel for weather · No rental insurance offered · 136 6th Avenue, Page, AZ · May 28 through September 25
